messages:
elaine.s: Morning — quick access question: I'm on my first day and I can't open the Redwood Console (staging). Going to /admin/flags gives me a 403 Forbidden. Who owns staging console perms or who should I ping?

samir: welcome @elaine.s! ping eng-infra or @luis_sec for SSO/group mapping. Can you paste the exact error text or headers?

elaine.s: sure — error shown in browser: "403 Forbidden - user requires console:admin role". Tried incognito + SSO. Email: elaine@redwood.com

kevin: hey Elaine, welcome! @luis_sec usually handles SSO attribute mappings. I can also grant a temporary role if you need to flip a flag urgently. Want a 24h `ff-operator` grant?

elaine.s: yes please — I need to flip a staging feature flag for a demo in ~2 hours.

kevin: ok created temporary grant. Details: role=ff-operator, expires=24h, ticket=REQ-7924. Use the staging console: https://console.staging.redwood.ai/flags. Try again and tell me if you still see 403.

auth-bot: Access grant issued by kevin (ticket REQ-7924). Grant expires in 24h. Audit entry created.

luis_sec: Elaine — looks like you weren't in the 'RDW-Console-Admins' SSO group so the console didn't map you to console:admin. I'll open an Okta assignment task. Short hint for the admins:

luis_sec: Steps to fix (Okta UI):
1) Applications → Redwood Console → Assignments
2) Add user → select Elaine
3) In app user profile set attribute `roles` = ["console_admin"] (or add `console_admin` to existing list)

luis_sec: note: staging and prod have different groups — prod uses 'RDW-Console-Admins-Prod' and needs an approval chain.

elaine.s: great, thanks. Only staging is needed for now.

samir: tagging @oncall_sre so SRE can monitor if you flip a flag that shifts traffic.

oncall_sre: noted. If you change a rollout/device flag, post the eval job id here and we'll watch latency/errs. Also let us know if you plan to flip >10% traffic.

elaine.s: will do. One quick question — how do I test via CLI if the console API is reachable? Any small curl I can run?

kevin: run:
`curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/admin/flags`

kevin: substitute $TOKEN with your session token (devtools → Application → auth cookie) — that'll show 200 if the mapping works.

elaine.s: thanks everyone — I can access the flags now after the temporary grant. I'll flip the test flag and post eval ID. Appreciate the fast help :smile:

kevin: glad it's working. After the demo we'll remove the temp grant — we'll follow up in the ticket REQ-7924.

luis_sec: I'll follow through with the Okta assignment so you get permanent staging access via SSO for your role. If anything else, DM me.

elaine.s: thanks all!
